name: Hello Extension
summary: SDK sample — one command that writes a log line (extensions/sdk/samples/hello-ext)
description:
The smallest possible Nexa SQL extension, built from extensions/sdk/samples/hello-ext with the nexa-ext-sdk crate: it declares one command (hello.say) and a context-menu group; running the command writes 'hello from wasm' to the app log (developer mode, ext layer).
Use it to check that the WASM runtime, the download/verify path and the command wiring work, and as the starting point for a new extension.
author: SosomLab

messages.install: Hello Extension is on — run 'Hello: Say Hi' from the command palette (log window shows the line).
